# Quant Development

The quant developer's stack. General software engineering (DSA, C++, system design, low-latency systems) lives in SDE-Interview-Prep; this section covers the quant-specific parts and bridges into that repo.

Runnable code: [code/cpp](code/cpp/) and [code/python](code/python/). Exchange protocol specifications: [protocol-specs](protocol-specs/).
See [SDE-Link-Map](../00-Start-Here/SDE-Link-Map.md) for everything that lives in SDE-Interview-Prep.
